name: Jotunheim
description: Jotunheim is the homeland of the Juten/Jotun. It is a place associated with significant revelations, including Sylan’s meditation there, which revealed that Gerk was the child described in his journal and was destined to become a keeper capable of opening doors.

log.summary: During the session, Sylan meditated in Jotunheim, where he received a revelation identifying Gerk as the child described in his journal. The vision also indicated that Gerk would serve as a keeper with the ability or role of opening doors.
notes: Sylan performed a meditation in Jotunheim that revealed Gerk as the child described in his journal and as a keeper who would open doors.
